name: @firstpick/pi-skill-explainer-video
description: Agent skill that turns a plain-language script into a short, silent tutorial or explainer video (MP4): close-up UI with smooth zooms, a glowing focus ring, numbered captions and an end card. Renders locally with headless Chromium and ffmpeg.
